name: mini-militia-wan
description: Mini Militia-style jetpack shooter for friends over the internet (WAN). See Mini-Militia-WAN-Plan/.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @game/server" "npm run dev -w @game/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @game/shared && npm run build -w @game/server && npm run build -w @game/client
